questions.question: At 20% discount the selling price of an article is Rs. 2400, what is the selling price (in Rs.) if the discount is 32.5%?
questions.solution:
Given: selling price of article = Rs. 2400 and discount = 20%

⇒ Marked price = 2400/(1 - 20/100)

⇒ Marked price = 2400/0.8

⇒ Marked price = 3000

Now, discount = 32.5%

⇒ New selling price = 3000(1 - 32.5/100) = 3000(.675)

∴ New selling price = Rs. 2025

questions.question: 20% of a = b, then b% of 20 is the same as _________ of a.
questions.solution:
Given: 20% of a = b

⇒ (20/100)a = b

⇒ a = 5b

⇒b% of 20 = ____ of 5b

Let the required % be c%

⇒ (b/100)(20) = (c/100)(5b)

⇒ 20 = 5c

∴ c = 4

questions.question: What is the value of Cot60° - Cos45°?
What is the average of all numbers between 8 and 74 which are divisible by 7?
questions.solution:
First number to be divisible by 7 in this range = 14

Last number to be divisible by 7 in this range = 70

This is an AP with difference = 7

Let the total numbers in this AP be n

⇒ Average = Sum of AP/total numbers

⇒ Average = [n/2(last term + first term)]/n

⇒ Average = (last term + first term)/2

∴ Average = (14 + 70)/2 = 42

questions.question: The slope of the line AB is -2/3. The co-ordinates of points A and B are (x, -3) and (5, 2) respectively. What is the value of x?
questions.solution:
Slope of a line joining 2 points (x₁, y₁) and (x₂, y₂) is (y₂ - y₁)/(x₂ - x₁).

So, -2/3 = [2 - (-3)]/(5 - x)

⇒ -2/3 = 5/(5 - x)

⇒ -10 + 2x = 15

∴ x = 25/2 = 12.5

questions.question: Even if A and C decide to merge, still D will have how many more taxis (in %) than the merged A and C entity?
questions.solution:
Number of taxis in A and C after the merge = 25 + 35 = 60

Number of taxis in D = 75

∴ Required % = [(75 - 60)/60] × 100 = (15/60)(100) = 25%

questions.question: What is the reflection of the point (4, 7) in the line y = -1?
questions.solution:
To find: reflection of the point (4, 7) in the line y = -1

The equation of line is: y + 1 = 0

The formula for finding the image of a point (x₁, y₁) to the line ax + by + c = 0 is given by:

(x - x₁)/a = (y - y₁)/b = -2(ax₁ + by₁ + c)/(a² + b²)

Here, a = 0, b = 1 and c = 1

So, we have

(x - 4) = 0 and (y - 7) = -2(7 + 1)/1

⇒ x = 4 and y = -16 + 7

∴ y = -9

questions.question: The 3rd and 7th term of an arithmetic progression are -9 and 11 respectively. What is the 15th term?
questions.solution:
Let the first term be a and the difference be d

⇒ a + (3 - 1)d = -9

⇒ a + 2d = -9 ----(i)

Similarly, a + 6d = 11 ----(ii)

Subtracting (i) from (ii)

⇒ 4d = 11 - (-9) = 20

⇒ d = 5

Putting d = 5 in (i), we get

⇒ a + 10 = -9

⇒ a = -19

∴ 15th term = a + 14d = -19 + 14 × 5 = 51

questions.question: A can do 75% of a job in 9 days and B can do half of the job in 8 days. If they work on it together, then in how many days can they do half of the job?
questions.solution:
Let the total work be a

Work done by A in 1 day = (75a/100)/9

Work done by B in 1 day = (a/2)/8

Work done by both in 1 day = a(1/12 + 1/16) = 7a/48

∴ days taken by both to do half of the work = (a/2)/(7a/48) = 24/7 days

Dividing by 5

questions.question: If a - b = 2 and ab = 24, then what is the value of a³ - b³?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

a - b = 2 and ab = 24

We know that: (a - b)³ = a³ - b³ - 3ab(a - b)

⇒ (2)³ = a³ - b³ - 3(24)(2)

⇒ 8 = a³ - b³ - 144

⇒ 144 + 8 = a³ - b³ 

∴ a³ - b³ = 152

questions.question: Sum of twice a fraction and its reciprocal is 17/6. What is the fraction?

questions.question: After excluding stoppages, the speed of a bus is 60 kmph and after including stoppages, it is 45 kmph. For how many minutes does the bus stop per hour?
questions.solution:
Given: Speed of bus excluding stoppages = 60km/hr

Speed of bus including stoppages = 45km/hr

∴ total time the bus stops in 1 hr = [(60 - 45)/60]hr = (15/60)hr = 1/4 hr = 15 minutes

questions.question: If Tan θ = 9/40, then Sec θ = ?
questions.solution:
We know that: tan²θ + 1 = Sec²θ

⇒ (9/40)² + 1 = Sec²θ

⇒ (9² + 40²)/(40)² = Sec²θ

⇒ (41/40)² = Sec²θ

Taking square root on both sides

⇒ 41/40 = Secθ

Negative value is neglected as there is only 3 option correct

questions.question: What are the co-ordinates of the centroid of a triangle, whose vertices are A(2, 5), B(-4, 0) and C(5, 4)?
questions.solution:
Centroid of a circle is the intersection of all the medians

Let the co-ordinates of centroid be (x, y)

⇒ x - coordinate = (x₁ + x₂ + x₃)/3 = (2 - 4 + 5)/3 = 1

⇒ y - coordinate = (y₁ + y₂ + y₃)/3 = (5 + 0 + 4)/3 = 3

So, (x, y) = (1, 3)

questions.question: A trader had 1200 kgs of rice. He sold a part of it at 5% profit and the rest at 11% profit, so that he made a total profit of 7%. How much (in kg) rice did he sell at 5% profit?
questions.solution:
Let the amount of rice he sold at 5% profit be a

Then, the amount of rice he sold at 11% profit will be (1200 - a)

Given: total profit = 7%

⇒ a(1 + 5/100) + (1200 - a)(1 + 11/100) = 1200(1 + 7/100)

⇒ 1.05a + 1332 - 1.11a = 1284

⇒ 0.06a = 1332 - 1284

⇒ a = 48/0.06

⇒ a = 800

∴ the amount of rice he sold at 5% profit = 800
